claims.text: LLMiser reads a .csv as comma-separated, guesses encoding from the bytes, writes one table; first row is header; rows padded to widest
Semicolon row Lee;10,50;Köln came out as Lee;10 and 50;Köln with all headers in one cell
.tsv came through as raw tab-separated text, not a table
Quoted file converted correctly; doubled quote became one; two-line note joined into one line
RFC 4180: fields with commas, quotes or line breaks enclosed in double quotes; inner quotes doubled
Unquoted copy: Paid in Note, ' then refunded' under Amount, 10.50 in a headerless fourth column
Windows-1252 names came out as Josķ N·±ez and Z³rich; UTF-8 with or without BOM came out right; already-garbled JosÃ© turned into Korean characters
CSV kept leading zeros 02134 where the workbook path lost them
Header-less file: first record became the headers, one data row left
RFC 4180 calls the header optional and expects it to have as many fields as the records
Ragged file: blank cell stayed blank, short row padded, extra field added an unnamed fourth column
